_meta.label: Value Proposition
_meta.instruction: The selected value proposition should dominate the ad. Other product features may appear only as supporting information. Do not dilute the main proposition by giving equal priority to every benefit.

structure.label: Structure
structure.definition: Dominate with the guided, day-wise, or course-like organization of the product.

hunger_support.label: Hunger Support
hunger_support.definition: Dominate with craving or hunger support, only using supplied product truths.

guidance.label: Guidance
guidance.definition: Dominate with food guidance, protocol clarity, or step-by-step instruction.

accountability.label: Accountability
accountability.definition: Dominate with coaches, check-ins, or consistency support.

simplicity.label: Simplicity
simplicity.definition: Dominate with how little extra planning the routine requires. Do not claim zero effort.

doctor_developed.label: Doctor Developed
doctor_developed.definition: Dominate with the supplied developer or clinical-practice origin.

guided_system.label: Guided System
guided_system.definition: Dominate with the product as a guided course rather than a loose supplement.

result_support.label: Result Support
result_support.definition: Dominate with the supported result window or progress framing. Do not guarantee outcomes.
